prerequisites: Basic technical knowledge from the modules of the first study section and from the already completed compulsory modules of the second study section.
Students should be able to name and reflect on their practical placement, their fields of activity, and initial technical or organizational questions from the practical study semester.

learning_outcomes.text: Classify professional tasks from the practical study semester within the context of an engineering activity and derive technical, organizational, and social requirements from them.
Structure technical and interdisciplinary tasks in a team, coordinate tasks, and independently develop results.
Apply technical knowledge from their studies to concrete practice-related questions and critically reflect on the limits of their own solution approaches.
Apply methods of collaboration, moderation, presentation, communication, and conflict resolution appropriately in a professional or project-related context.
Systematically reflect on their own practical experiences and draw conclusions for further studies, personal competence development, and future work as an engineer.
Discuss technical decisions and professional actions taking into account responsibility, ethics, sustainability, quality, and economic constraints.
Purposefully use digital tools, learning platforms, or collaborative work environments for processing, documenting, and presenting practice-related tasks.

syllabus_topics: Processing practice-related technical or organizational tasks in a team
Communication, moderation, presentation, and rhetoric in the technical professional field
Teamwork, conflict management, feedback, and self-organization
Scientific work, technical documentation, and structured reflection of practical experiences
Ethical, social, and sustainability-related issues of technical decisions
Entrepreneurship, innovation, project work, quality, and economic constraints in the technical environment
Use of digital tools, alternative teaching and learning platforms, and collaborative forms of work
Workshops, seminars, excursions, further training courses, or similar seminar-based formats related to professionally oriented competencies
assessment_rules: The proof of achievement is earned within the practical seminar. It can consist of active participation in seminar units, workshops, exercises, excursions, or further training, as well as the processing, documentation, presentation, or reflection of a practice-oriented task. The specific design of the proof of achievement will be announced at the beginning of the course. It is considered "successfully passed" if students have fully completed the required seminar-related contributions and demonstrate their ability to apply the module's learning outcomes to a specific professional or practice-oriented question.
